now_the_spec_says: A probe's pointer is a FILE PATH, not an id: the path is the link, the filesystem is the index, no receiver resolves anything. by_copy narrows to a receiver that cannot read that filesystem, else it goes. An intention owns its tickets; self-ownership gates nothing.
